title: Sinusoidal Measurement (PLL)
text: Estimate sinusoidal characteristics using a phase-locked loop, 1 input, 3 outputs, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Phase detector integral gain} sets the pD integral gain, {Loop filter proportional gain} sets the lF proportional gain, {Loop filter integral gain} sets the lF integral gain, {Initial frequency (Hz)} sets the initial frequency, {Initial phase angle (rad)} sets the initial phase and {Initial magnitude}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Phase detector integral gain
params.values: PD integral gain 1000 (default) | positive scalar or vector

params.name: Loop filter proportional gain
params.values: LF proportional gain 400 (default) | positive scalar or vector

params.name: Loop filter integral gain
params.values: LF integral gain 20000 (default) | positive scalar or vector

params.name: Initial frequency (Hz)
params.values: Initial frequency 60 Hz (default) | scalar or vector

params.name: Initial phase angle (rad)
params.values: Initial phase 0 rad (default) | scalar or vector
